rules.accepted_credit_types: AOTA or OTAC programs, post-professional coursework at an accredited institution, or any activity that contributes directly to professional knowledge and is objectively measurable in hours; no Board pre-approval of courses, online/home study allowed with a completion certificate. Up to 12 PDUs from the 4161(c) list: study groups (3 h = 1 PDU, max 6), being mentored or mentoring (20 h = 3 PDUs, max 6 each), fieldwork supervision (Level I 1 PDU per student, Level II 1 PDU per 40 h, max 12), publications (5–10 PDUs each, max 10), presenting (2 PDUs per hour, max 6), Board meetings (2 PDUs each, max 6), Board outreach (2 PDUs each, max 4).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first renewal after the initial license (16 CCR §4161(e)).
rules.carryover: Up to 6 PDUs above the 24 may be carried to the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Certify completion on the renewal form and list each activity; do not send documents unless audited. Keep records 4 years after the renewal period; missing records lead to citation/fine or discipline.
rules.notes: 1 PDU = 1 hour of participation; 1 CEU = 10 PDUs; 1 academic credit = 10 PDUs. At least half of the PDUs (12) must relate directly to the delivery of OT services. Licenses expire the last day of the birth month in odd years for those born in odd years, even years for those born in even years. Renewal fee $270 OT, $210 OTA. Exemptions (16 CCR §4163) for a year+ abroad, military service, disability; not two periods in a row.
rules.rule_quote: (a) Each licensee renewing a license under Section 2570.10 of the Code shall submit evidence of meeting continuing competency requirements by having completed 24 professional development units (PDUs) during the preceding renewal period,…
